cues.en: Now this particular algorithm for neural collaborative filtering in lib recommender actually is built on top of PyTorch instead of TensorFlow.

cues.en: It doesn't really matter in the context of using Lib recommender because that's all abstracted away from you.
cues.zh: 使用 LibRecommender 時，沒差，因為都已抽象化。

cues.en: But it does mean that we need to install PyTorch first before we install lib recommender to make sure things actually work.
cues.zh: 但表示要先裝 PyTorch，再裝 LibRecommender，確保運作。

cues.en: So that's all we're doing in this first block here, we're installing torch, which is PyTorch and the Lib Recommender package itself.
cues.zh: 第一區塊，只安裝 torch，也就是 PyTorch，以及 LibRecommender 套件。

cues.en: I've already done that.
cues.zh: 我已做過。

cues.en: So for me it won't actually do anything interesting, but for you it should go out and install those packages, which will take a few minutes.
cues.zh: 對我不會有什麼特別，但你應該會安裝套件，需要幾分鐘。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that's done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.zh: 接著匯入所需套件。

cues.zh: 是 Python 標準資料分析套件。從 LibRecommender，

cues.en: We're going to import random split just for splitting out our training and test and evaluation data sets and also data set pure again, data set pure just means it's a data set of pure collaborative filtering

cues.en: data users items and ratings, and not something that includes additional metadata for content based recommendations.

cues.en: We import the Nqf neural collaborative filtering model from the algorithms package and finally, the evaluate package so we can evaluate the quality of the results that we get.
cues.zh: 從 algorithms 匯入 NCF 模型，最後匯入 evaluate，評估結果品質。

cues.en: So that will go off and import what we need.
cues.zh: 會匯入所需內容。

cues.en: Again, it will take a minute to import all that stuff into our environment.
cues.zh: 同樣，需要一點時間，全部載入環境。

cues.en: All right, that finished loading up.
cues.zh: 好，完成。

cues.en: And when you're dealing with these newer and more complicated packages here, it's not unusual to get warning messages just due to internal conflicts between versions.
cues.zh: 這些較新、複雜套件，因內部版本衝突，出現警告很常見。

cues.en: As long as it's a warning and not an error, you should be okay.
cues.zh: 只要警告不是錯誤，應該沒問題。

cues.en: Next, we're going to import our data for training and you can see how easy that is.
cues.zh: 接著匯入訓練資料，很容易。

cues.en: So we're just going to go ahead and use the latest small data set from Movielens that we've been using throughout this course.
cues.zh: 用整門課一直使用的 MovieLens latest-small。

cues.en: And all we have to do is load that up from a CSV file directly into Pandas, and then we can say that the columns of that CSV data are named user item, label and time.
cues.zh: 只需把 CSV 直接載入 pandas，再把欄名設為 user、item、label、time。

cues.en: Do the same thing for the movies dot csv file where we import the movie ID and look that up based on title and genres.
cues.zh: movies.csv 也相同，匯入 movieId，以及片名、類型，供查詢。

cues.en: We'll use that later on to make sense of the results that we're getting and and be able to print out the movie titles instead of the movie ID So we get more of a subjective feel as to how good these recommendations
cues.zh: 稍後用它理解結果，印電影名稱，而不是 ID，才能主觀感受推薦

cues.en: might be.
cues.zh: 好不好。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: That's all there is to loading up the data.
cues.zh: 載入就這樣。

cues.en: That's our pre-processing.
cues.zh: 這就是前處理。

cues.en: Pretty easy.
cues.zh: 很容易。

cues.en: Next, we're going to split that data into, well, let's run this cell first before we forget real quick.
cues.zh: 接著分割資料，先別忘了，執行這格。

cues.en: And now we're going to split that up into our training evaluation and testing sets.
cues.zh: 現在分訓練、評估、測試集。

cues.en: So we're going to assign 80% to training one, 10% to evaluation during training and 1% for testing after the fact.
cues.zh: 80% 給訓練、10% 給訓練期間評估、1% 給事後測試。

cues.en: And we'll just go ahead and kick that off.
cues.zh: 開始執行。

cues.en: Finally, we need to prepare this data into the format that lib recommender expects.
cues.zh: 最後，準備成 LibRecommender 預期格式。

cues.en: So again, we're setting up a pure data set here.
cues.zh: 同樣，設定純資料集。

cues.en: Data set pure just means that it's pure collaborative filtering data.
cues.zh: DatasetPure，就是純協同過濾資料。

cues.en: There's no additional content based information there.
cues.zh: 沒有額外內容資訊。

cues.en: It's just users items and labels and times, right?
cues.zh: 只有使用者、項目、標籤、時間，對吧？

cues.en: So that's all we got going on here.
cues.zh: 僅此而已。

cues.en: And they do expect it to be in those those column names, by the way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，確實要求那些欄名。

cues.en: That is important.
cues.zh: 很重要。

cues.en: So we just load that up that way.
cues.zh: 所以，就這樣載入。

cues.en: We convert it using data set pure and we build our evaluation data set based on the evaluation set that we split off using random split and also the test data set again, that came out of random split.
cues.zh: 用 DatasetPure 轉換，再依 random_split 分出的評估集與測試集，建立評估與測試資料。

cues.en: So we have three data set peers here for training, evaluation and testing at this point.
cues.zh: 此時，有訓練、評估、測試三個 DatasetPure。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and run that.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: Next, we need to load up our model.
cues.zh: 接著載入模型。

cues.en: We want the neural collaborative filtering model.
cues.zh: 要 NCF。

cues.en: And it's just this easy.
cues.zh: 非常容易。

cues.en: All we're going to do is say that it's task is to predict ratings and we're going to feed in the data info which contains the information about all the training data that we just created.
cues.zh: 只指定 task 是預測評分，傳入 data_info，包含剛建立的所有訓練資料資訊。

cues.en: And if you do want to read the defaults for the other hyperparameters, you can refer to it here at this link for the documentation for the Nqf algorithm within lib recommender, the defaults should be
cues.zh: 其他超參數預設，可到連結看 LibRecommender NCF 文件，預設應是

cues.en: reasonable starting points, but if you do want to go back and fiddle with this thing and try to get better results, you might want to look that up.
cues.zh: 合理起點；但想再調、改善結果，可查查。

cues.en: And again, depending on the model you're using, there will be different hyperparameters available to tweak.
cues.zh: 同樣，不同模型，有不同超參數可調。

cues.en: You just have to refer to the documentation to see what those might be.
cues.zh: 只要看文件。

cues.en: And it's just as easy for any of the other algorithms as well.
cues.zh: 其他演算法也一樣容易。

cues.en: So if you want to do a bake off of neural collaborative filtering against the other algorithms that Lib Recommender offers, it's really easy to do that just by swapping that out.
cues.zh: 想讓 NCF 與 LibRecommender 其他演算法比較，只要替換，很容易。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and kick that off.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And now that we've created the model, we're going to train it.
cues.zh: 模型建立後，要訓練。

cues.en: This is the part that takes a while, so we're just going to call fit on that model that we just created for neural collaborative filtering pass in our training data, we're going to set negative sampling
cues.zh: 這部分耗時，對剛建立的 NCF 模型呼叫 fit，傳訓練資料，把負取樣設為

cues.en: to false.
cues.zh: False。

cues.en: The practice here is that if you have explicit ratings like we do in the Movielens dataset, negative sampling will be false.
cues.zh: 慣例是，像 MovieLens 這種明確評分，負取樣設 False。

cues.en: It's true for implicit data.
cues.zh: 隱含資料，則 True。

cues.en: So that's relevant because for implicit data, that's only positive data, right?
cues.zh: 因為隱含資料，只有正面資料，對吧？

cues.en: So we need what's called negative sampling to balance that out.
cues.zh: 所以需要負取樣，平衡。

cues.en: We're going to print out verbose results.
cues.zh: 印出詳細結果。

cues.en: We want to see what's going on.
cues.zh: 想知道發生什麼事。

cues.en: And we're also going to pass in an evaluation data set for measuring its progress as training goes on.
cues.zh: 也傳入評估資料集，衡量訓練進度。

cues.en: And we're going to print out the loss metric as we go.
cues.zh: 過程中，印損失指標。

cues.en: Go ahead and kick that off.
cues.zh: 開始執行。

cues.en: And this will, of course, take a while, even with a GPU.
cues.zh: 即使 GPU，當然也需要時間。

cues.en: Let's see how long it takes.
cues.zh: 看看多久。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's dig into the results here as we went.
cues.zh: 深入看過程結果。

cues.en: And we can see that we're printing out the train loss metric here as well as Rmse.
cues.zh: 印了訓練損失，以及 RMSE。

cues.en: Obviously, we want those to be going down over time.
cues.zh: 顯然，希望隨時間下降。

cues.en: And as we scroll through here, we can see that our loss started off at one point.
cues.zh: 捲動，能看到損失一開始是 1.

cues.en: One nine quickly goes down to 0.785, then 0.70 0.6 and it just gets lower and lower.
But you can see we're starting to hit some diminishing returns as we get to around Epoch ten where it finally stopped.
cues.zh: 但約第十個週期，開始報酬遞減，看來停止了。

cues.en: So that's probably a reasonable stopping point.
cues.zh: 所以，可能是合理停止點。

cues.en: Epoch ten You could maybe go a little bit further.
cues.zh: 第十個週期，也許還能再多一點。

cues.en: It went to 11, 12, 13 actually went all the way to 20 before it gave up and we got all the way down to 0.2 there and an MSC score of 1.0161.
cues.zh: 到 11、12、13，其實一直到 20 才停，損失降到 0.2，RMSE 是 1.0161。

cues.en: So it looks like it was doing the right thing and getting better with each epoch, which is what we want to see.
cues.zh: 看來方向正確，每週期改善，符合期待。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and evaluate the results with this next block.
cues.zh: 用下一區塊評估。

cues.en: And this is coming straight out of the boilerplate stuff that Lib Recommender gives you.
cues.zh: 直接來自 LibRecommender 固定範例。

cues.en: And we can see the loss metric in the end was 1.02 measured against our testing set as opposed to the evaluation data that we were measuring above.
cues.zh: 最後，測試集損失指標 1.02，不是上面用的評估資料。

cues.en: So that's why we're getting two different numbers there.
cues.zh: 所以兩個數字不同。

cues.en: But that's a better metric of the model's performance because we're testing it against information that it hasn't seen before.
cues.zh: 這是更好的模型表現指標，因為測試從沒看過的資訊。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Again, nothing fancy there.
cues.zh: 沒什麼複雜。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and apply this model that we've trained.
cues.zh: 應用訓練好的模型。

cues.en: So let's start by printing out every movie that user one rated.
cues.zh: 先印使用者一，評分過的每部電影。

cues.en: So we're going to use user one as our test subject.
cues.zh: 以使用者一作測試對象。

cues.en: So first we need to wrap our heads around what user one's tastes are.
cues.zh: 先理解他的品味。

cues.en: We have this metric of 1.02 that tells us how good our our model is on paper, but it's always good to sort of see what it actually is doing subjectively as well.
cues.zh: 1.02，告訴我們模型理論表現，但總是應該也主觀看看實際做什麼。

cues.en: So if we run that, all we're going to do is go through every single rating that's associated with user ID one.
cues.zh: 執行，只走訪使用者 ID 一的每筆評分。

cues.zh: 用這個小運算子。

cues.en: And for each one we're going to print out the label, which is the rating, also the movie title.
cues.zh: 每筆印標籤，也就是評分，以及片名。

cues.zh: 用前面載入的電影 DataFrame 查詢，也印出。能看到，Dangerous Minds 只給 2.5 星，Dumbo，

cues.en: three stars.
cues.zh: 三顆星。

cues.en: ET cetera.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: ET cetera.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: So we can kind of get a feel here that, well, they like Cinema Paradiso.
cues.zh: 可以感覺，他喜歡 Cinema Paradiso。

cues.en: That's kind of an artsy film, right?
cues.zh: 有點藝術片，對吧？

cues.en: They didn't like The Deer Hunter.
cues.zh: 不喜歡 The Deer Hunter。

cues.en: They didn't like Ben-Hur or Gandhi.
cues.zh: 不喜歡 Ben-Hur、Gandhi。

cues.en: So apparently they don't like, you know, big epic movies.
cues.zh: 顯然不喜歡大型史詩片。

cues.en: They were okay with Dracula, Didn't really like Star Trek, hated Beavis and Butt-Head, like the French Connection.
cues.zh: Dracula 還可以，不太喜歡 Star Trek，討厭 Beavis and Butt-Head，喜歡 The French Connection。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm getting the feel that this person has a thing for artsy foreign films.
cues.zh: 好，感覺喜歡藝術外國片。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: And very much does not like more lowbrow stuff, if you will.
cues.zh: 很不喜歡較通俗的東西。

cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and predict the rating of user one to movie one, which is a Toy story.
cues.zh: 預測使用者一，對電影一，也就是 Toy Story 的評分。

cues.zh: 果然，預測只有 2.2。

cues.en: We can also use this to recommend items top end recommenders.
cues.zh: 也能推薦項目，做 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: So we just say recommend underscore user on our model there and we say what user we want user ID one and how many recommendations we want.
cues.zh: 對模型呼叫 recommend_user，指定使用者 ID 一，以及推薦數量。

cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: Go ahead and print them out and we can see that we got back a list of recommendations for movie IDs.
cues.zh: 印出，能看到傳回電影 ID 推薦清單。

ET cetera.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: But that's hard to interpret.
cues.zh: 但很難解讀。

cues.en: So let's print out what those are.

cues.en: I'm going to take that recommendation vector back there and just print out a lookup of what those movie titles are by matching against the movies data frame that we loaded up earlier.
